bit_fields.name: ForceRefClkToOutClk_b
bit_fields.description: A value of 1'b0 overrides OutClkMuxSel and forces RefClk to OutClk. Intended to be used when DsClk becomes flat lined while being selected by OutClkMuxSel.

bit_fields.name: OutClkMuxSel
bit_fields.description: Control signal that select the clock source for OutClk.1'b0: RefClk1'b1: DsClkNote: All clocks must be toggling in order for changes on control signal to take effect.

bit_fields.name: FcsTrig
bit_fields.description: Trigger signal that engages FCS for SlvOsc. Posedge sensitive.

bit_fields.name: FcsFromRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal indicating if FCS should take FcsEnable and FcsAmount from sideband or DFLL internal registers. 1'b0 indicates values from sideband should be used. 1'b1 indicates values from DFLL internal registers should be used.

bit_fields.name: DsTrig
bit_fields.description: Trigger signal that engages DS for OutClk. Posedge sensitive.

bit_fields.name: DsEnable
bit_fields.description: Enables DS Divider. Note: This pin is not part of the UpdateDsReq-Ack interface.

bit_fields.name: ForceRefClk_or_MstrOscClk_b
bit_fields.description: A value of 1'b0 overrides DfllOscClkMuxSel[1] and forces either RefClk or MstrOscClkFn to DfllOscClk. The selection between RefClk and MstrOscClkFn is determined by ForceRefClk_b and DfllOscClkMuxSel[0]. Intended to be used when SlvOscClkFn is flat lined while being selected by DfllOscClkMuxSel[1].

bit_fields.name: ForceRefClk_b
bit_fields.description: A value of 1'b0 overrides DfllOscClkMuxSel[0] and forces RefClk to be muxed with SlvOscClkFn for DfllOscClk. Intended to be used when MstrOscClkFn is flat lined while being selected by DfllOscClkMuxSel[0].

bit_fields.name: DfllOscClkMuxSel
bit_fields.description: Control signals that select the clock source for DfllOscClk.2'b00: RefClk2'b01: MstrOscClkFn2'b1x: SlvOscClkFnNote: All clocks must be toggling in order for changes on control signals to take effect.

bit_fields.name: SSFromRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal indicating if SSG should take SSEnable, SSRampStep, SSRampInterval, SSRampNum and SSFinishRamp from sideband or DFLL internal registers. 1'b0 indicates values from sideband should be used. 1'b1 indicates values from DFLL internal registers should be used.

bit_fields.name: FcwSlv_CntrlThruRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal that overrides the FcwRetainer output with FCW value from DFLL internal register to become FcwSlv. Together with FcwSlv_CntrlThruSideband, determines the source of FcwSlv. 1'b1 with FcwSlv_CntrlThruSideband at 1'b0 indicates FcwSlv to come from DFLL internal register. 1'b0 with FcwSlv_CntrlThruSideband at 1'b0 indicates FcwSlv to come from FcwRetainer

bit_fields.name: FcwSlv_CntrlThruSideband
bit_fields.description: Control signal that overrides the FcwRetainer output with the FCW value from sideband to become FcwSlv. 1'b1 indicates FcwSlv to come from sideband. 1'b0 indicates FcwSlv to be determined by the status of FcwSlv_CntrlThruRegister

bit_fields.name: CntrlThruRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal that overrides the PI output with the FCW value from DFLL internal register to become FcwMstr. Together with CntrlThruSideband, determines the source of FcwMstr. 1'b1 with CntrlThruSideband at 1'b0 indicates FcwMstr to come from DFLL internal register. 1'b0 with CntrlThruSideband at 1'b0 indicates FcwMstr to come from PI.

bit_fields.name: CntrlThruSideband
bit_fields.description: Control signal that overrides the PI output with the FCW value from sideband to become FcwMstr. 1'b1 indicates FcwMstr to come from sideband. 1'b0 indicates FcwMstr to be determined by the status of CntrlThruRegister

bit_fields.name: DfllSlvConfigAFromRegister

bit_fields.name: DfllMstrConfigAFromRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal indicating if MstrOsc should take MstrVREnable, MstrHsClkDivSyncCellResetn, MstrDcoDivClkEnable, MstrRefCEBypass and MstrDrpCEBypass from sideband or DFLL internal registers. 1'b0 indicates values from sideband should be used. 1'b1 indicates values from DFLL internal registers should be used.

bit_fields.name: DfllLCConfigFromRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal indicating if LoopCntrl should take EnableLC from sideband or DFLL internal registers. 1'b0 indicates EnableLC from sideband should be used. 1'b1 indicates values from DFLL internal registers should be used.

bit_fields.name: SlvVoltCodeFromRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal indicating if MstrVoltCntrl should take MstrVoltCode from sideband or DFLL internal registers. 1'b0 indicates MstrVoltCode from sideband should be used. 1'b1 indicates values from DFLL internal registers should be used.

bit_fields.name: VoltCodeFromRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal indicating if MstrVoltCntrl should take MstrVoltCode from sideband or DFLL internal registers. 1'b0 indicates MstrVoltCode from sideband should be used. 1'b1 indicates values from DFLL internal registers should be used.

bit_fields.name: FreqCntFromRegister
bit_fields.description: Control signal indicating if FreqCntrl should take OutClkCnt and RefClkCnt values from sideband or DFLL internal registers. 1'b0 indicates OutClkCnt and RefClkCnt values from sideband should be used. 1'b1 indicates values from DFLL internal registers should be used.

bit_fields.name: FcsEngaged
bit_fields.description: Status flag indicating FCS is engaged. Non-sticky flag.

bit_fields.name: DsEngaged
bit_fields.description: Status flag indicating DS is engaged. Non-sticky flag.

bit_fields.name: SSEngaged
bit_fields.description: Status flag indicating SSG is engaged. Non-sticky flag.

bit_fields.name: TargetSlvVrefAcquired
bit_fields.description: Status flag indicating Subordinate VREF has reached its target voltage level. Non-sticky flag.

bit_fields.name: TargetVrefAcquired
bit_fields.description: Status flag indicating Manager VREF has reached its target voltage level. Non-sticky flag.

bit_fields.name: FcwSlvLocked
bit_fields.description: Status flag indicating shadow Subordinate FCW is locked by monitoring the DFLL internal FcwSlvErrBelowThreshold bit. This flag is asserted when the error between target Subordinate FCW (before SSG) and current shadow Subordinate FCW (before SSG) is below the threshold specified by the FcwSlvDeltaTol register for longer than the number of consecutive RefClk cycles specified by the FcwSlvLockTimerValue register. Non-sticky flag.

bit_fields.name: FreqLocked
bit_fields.description: Status flag indicating MstrOsc frequency locked by monitoring the DFLL internal FreqErrBelowThreshold bit. This flag is asserted when the error between MstrOscClkFb frequency and target OutClk frequency is below the threshold specified by the PIFreqLockTol register for longer than the number of consecutive RefClk cycles specified by the FreqLockTimerValue register. Non-sticky flag.

bit_fields.name: OutClkCntAcquired
bit_fields.description: Status flag indicating the MstrOsc has achieved its target maximum frequency. This flag is not affected by SlvOsc stretching OutClk. Non-sticky flag.

bit_fields.name: UpdateDsAck
bit_fields.description: Acknowledge to UpdateDsReq. 1'b1 indicates affirmation. Clears when UpdateDsReq clears. 1'b1 does not mean DS is engaged; it is simply an indication that the new DsDiv value has been captured by DS Divider.

bit_fields.name: SSRampAck
bit_fields.description: Acknowledge to SSRampReq.. 1'b1 indicates affirmation. Clears when SSRampReq clears. 1'b1 does not mean SSG is engaged; it is simply an indication that the new SSEnable, SSRampStep, SSRampInterval, SSRampNum and SSFinishRamp values have been captured by SSG.

bit_fields.name: UpdateSlvVoltCodeAck
bit_fields.description: Acknowledge to UpdateSlvVoltCodeReq. 1'b1 indicates affirmation. Clears when UpdateSlvVoltCodeReq clears. 1'b1 does not mean target Subordinate VREF has been acquired; it is simply an indication that the new SlvVoltCode has been captured by SlvVoltCntrl.

bit_fields.name: UpdateVoltCodeAck
bit_fields.description: Acknowledge to UpdateVoltCodeReq. 1'b1 indicates affirmation. Clears when UpdateVoltCodeReq clears. 1'b1 does not mean target Manager VREF has been acquired, It is simply an indication that the new MstrVoltCode has been captured by MstrVoltCntrl.

bit_fields.name: UpdateCntAck
bit_fields.description: Acknowledge to UpdateCntReq. 1'b1 indicates affirmation. Clears when UpdateCntReq clears. 1'b1 does not mean target maximum frequency has been acquired; It is simply an indication that the new OutClkCnt and RefClkCnt values have been captured by FreqCntrl.
